title: Payload at the Virtual Input Head
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word and let $c$ be a machine configuration on $x$. The virtual input payload at the integer coordinate one less than the configuration's input-head position equals the pair consisting of the symbol read by the input head and the boundary tag: tag $1$ at the left boundary, tag $2$ at the right boundary, and tag $0$ at every other input-head position.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration c with a natural-number input-head position
replaced:
For every configuration of a binary machine on an input $x$ with input head at
position $p$, the virtual input payload of $x$ at coordinate $p - 1$ is exactly the
pair of the symbol read by the native input head and the boundary tag of that
configuration; on the empty input both boundary tags are produced correctly.
